name: Sangoma

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, <cmdr>. Your milk is ready. Oh my, you don't seem fully awake yet. I don't mind you napping a little longer on my thighs, you know?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I'm testing the efficacy of certain herbs... Would you like to try this concoction? Hehe, these are simply body-strengthening herbs; they don't have any strange effects.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Zzz... Ah, did I fall asleep? Pardon me... my model is older than most so it's a little difficult for me to remain on standby for a while. Why don't you come sleep with me? It's only for a little while, so it'll be fine, no?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: It's time for all good children to sleep~ If you can't get to sleep, I can tell you a bedtime story too. Once, there was a poor little child who was too tired and ended up falling while gathering herbs. His sickle sliced his neck open and blood spurted everywhere... Hm? That makes it even harder to sleep?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Oh dear, I can't see... Hm, I have this problem while picking herbs too; this form of mine does get in the way at times and my shoulders get sore easily. Hm, you want to give me a massage? Please and thank you.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: You want to know about this scythe? Hehehe... Well, it's the "Grim Reaper's Scythe"... it reaps the lives of naughty kids who won't do as they're told... Hehehe, you don't have to make that face. I know you're a good kid, aren't you, <cmdr>?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Hehehe, to think <cmdr> actually fell asleep. How adorable... Mhmhmhmhm♪... Hmmhmhm♪~

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: I simply chased a few bothersome bugs away... Don't worry, I won't let my precious herbs come to harm.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Take your time, I have so much to teach you...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Ara... You're so naughty, <cmdr>~ Don't worry, I won't tell anyone else...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Do you want to rest? Come to me.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Come closer, <cmdr>. I don't bite... hard.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Since you're asking... there's no way I can say no...

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: It's been a while... No, should I say, "nice to meet you"? My name is Sangoma, and this time, I won't let you forget me again.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I see... Hehehe, how interesting.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I feel like I know more now... More about you.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I didn't think I had a side like this to me, hehehe...

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Make sure you hide behind me if there's trouble, okay?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: I will not fail.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Let's try a new remedy.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: The useless weeds have been cleared.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: I won't let anyone stop us.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: A healer... must be kind...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Wha?! Is, is this for me? you do know the significance of doing this, right? This is a very important ceremony, and if we do make this oath, then from now on... I see, so you've already given it great thought. I understand your intentions now... Then yes, I do. I will spend the rest of my life by your side. That said, you do know my love is a weighty thing, right? If you betrayed me, I don't know what I'd do. So you must make sure you keep your word, alright? Hehehe, then I'll be in your care from now on.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: A new year has come once again. Time certainly flies. Who would have expected that adorably clueless child from back then to be able to stand independent now? Still, there are many things you can't just take on all by yourself, alright? Please take care of your body, make sure you get enough to eat, and if there's something you just can't deal with on your own, feel free to depend on me. May you have a happy new year and may everything go your way, <cmdr>.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Ara, thank you for your chocolate, but eating too many sweets is bad for your body, you know? Especially considering how sweet you usually take your coffee...
...Ah, so today's Valentine's Day, then? To think I didn't notice; how embarrassing! Give me a moment, I'll go make some chocolate for you now, with some extra Chinese peony, female ginseng, China root, baizhu... huh? I don't need to add all that?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: In stories, the 7th day of the 7th month is when the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl meet upon a bridge of magpies. They probably spend the rest of the year pining for each other. As someone who's wandered as long as I have, the feeling of knowing that someone's waiting for you to come back to them is so wonderful that I'm actually a little envious. That's why you need to stay by my side all the time, so I never have to feel the loneliness of separation again, <cmdr>~

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: It seems many guests have come to the Oasis today, all clamoring and fighting with each other for my candy. It's such an adorable sight, but alas I have no candy, only some freshly-made donkey-hide gelatin. I hope it doesn't disappoint. I didn't expect candy to be the popular choice for making guests; it seems I'll have to make extra on a daily basis.... Hm? So you're saying they aren't guests, but agents from the Oasis in costume?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: ! It's a snowy day, so make sure you keep warm, alright? Here, put on this scarf. Honestly, your hands are so cold... (Blows) There, do you feel a little warmer now? Oh yes, if you hang a stocking from your bedpost, you'll find what you want inside it the very next dy. So... what do you want, ? If you tell me, your wish will definitely come true.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, <cmdr>. Today is a very special day, and so I've prepared many gifts for you. Apart from the birthday cake, there are also nourishing tonics I've concocted for you, unguents for when you're hurt, and pills for when you catch cold... Don't worry about not being able to tell them apart; I've labelled them all. That way, you won't have to worry about getting sick, even when I'm not by your side, and this new year of your life will be spent in perfect health.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Hehehe, it's been so long since we last met, and it seems you've grown into a leader of which I can be proud, <cmdr>. As a reward, allow me to give you a hug filled with my love... Hm? That's no good? But you used to like them so much before. This sense of separation makes me feel a little lonely...

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: <cmdr>, come closer and let me take a good look at you... Mm, your face is pink, your breathing and blood pressure are normal, and you seem to be the very picture of health. Be good now, take this pill... Oh my, you don't have to be so nervous; my medical skills are quite advanced, you know? And considering I'm a herbalist, it makes sense that I'd have herbs with me too, don't you think? So be at ease and take it; my after-sales service includes a lifelong guarantee~

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
You want to know about my past? Oh my, that's too long for a short talk. Would you like to hear a story about how I trekked into the wilderness to find herbs, or what I did in Ultilife HQ, or a story from my time in the Guardians? Or... would you prefer to hear about the time we spent together in the past? I'll never get tired of telling you about stories from that time.
Hm? You want to listen to all of them? Hehehe, how greedy you are. I'll start from the beginning, then...

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Hehe, you have a look of curiosity on your face, <cmdr>. This is a talisman I made for those kids in Arcadia. It's filled with a scent pouch that lifts people's spirits. At first, it was just to locate people better, but at some point it became a keepsake of the Guardians... hehehe, when I first made those talismans, I never expected the Guardians to grow to the size that they did.
Oh yes, I made this talisman a long time ago, but I've finally gotten the chance to give to you now. It has your name on it, but I'm not good at needlework, so it might be a little hard to read... Will you take it?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Humans are truly possessed of infinite potential, and you've walked further down your path than I anticipated. It makes me wonder if you really will be able to change this world someday... I wonder if I'll be able to witness that moment, but... Mmm, I'm sure that if anyone can do it, it will be you. Being able to see you grow like this makes me very happy, <cmdr>.

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Mhm.

voices.label: Praise
voices.text: How lovely.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Aww...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe~

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Ara ara...

voices.label: Live2D1
voices.text: ..Haaah... Haaah... Feel better now?

voices.label: Live2D2
voices.text: Anh... anh~

voices.label: Live2D3
voices.text: Anh~ you're so naughty~

career:
The UL-TMR was one of the first to be employed in the field of research, and its primary focus includes the collection and analysis of medicinal herbs, as well as the research and compounding of various herbological recipes. Initially, the UL-TMR was a project that was jointly developed by multiple research groups and a Doll manufacturer, but the project was later acquired and completed by Ultilife, which had plans to break into the Doll market. As one of the earliest models of Dolls ever developed, Ultilife did not market it to the general public out of concerns for the maturity of the technology. Instead, it was used for internal experimentation and testing and classified as a secret project.

The UL-TMR unit known as "Sangoma" is quite similar to her peers both in terms of her body and her neural cloud. Her systems show signs of repeated module installations and her neural cloud has been encrypted in order to ensure technical security. Her system complexity and experiences are every bit as unique as she is, making her extremely valuable, which was the reason why she was chosen to take part in Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
As mentioned earlier, the UL-TMR was developed from a joint project where several medical organizations planned to collaboratively develop a Doll that could be used to research traditional medical practices, following which they began working with a tech startup. Unsurprisingly, there was severe internal friction within the project group, and it ultimately stagnated. What was originally a dead-end undertaking was drew the attention of Ultilife, which had plans to break into the Doll market. They purchased all project assets at a reasonable price and shortly after, they completed the development of the Doll in question. Said Doll's product line was dubbed the UL-TMR, with an internal code of "U0-1" to represent it going from "zero" to "one".

While the course of the UL-TMR's development had been complex and treacherous, the unit known as "Sangoma" - the Zulu word for "healer" has a background and CV that can only be described as "mysterious". Sangoma's model exhibits all the hallmarks of first-generation Dolls and her body's serial number has been altered many times, and in the end she was registered as simply UL-TMR in the company database. Such situations are typically only found in black-market "cleaning" services, which many organizations have used to cover up all traces of a Doll's existence. Considering Ultilife has ever been the center of public controversy and criticism, perhaps such a course of action was not particularly remarkable. 

Sangoma's neural cloud module was upgraded mid-career. Since it was forcibly transferred to new hardware, many functions could only be replicated through simulation, which led to compatibility issues and the inability to edit her neural cloud data like could be done with other second-generation Dolls. This unique feature could be considered a defect, but it also had a far-reaching impact on her personality, convictions and future career.

Sangoma's background and career can be summarized in just a few words, such as "complex", "baffling" and "mysterious". Very little in there can be solidly verified and some of the information is downright contradictory. 
—————— 
[Sangoma was born near the end of WW3. Unlike the vast majority of military-use tin cans, she was among the first Doll prototypes furnished with a full humanoid appearance.] 
[Note: While mimetic humanform exteriors only made their debut after the end of the war, it's not exactly strange that research into the relevant technologies was being carried out beforehand.] 
—————— 
[Sangoma is, in the truest sense, Ultilife's first Doll development project, predating even the UL-TMR model. Due to a lack of technical experience and expertise, Ultilife could only make alterations to the existing first-generation Doll chassis, which led to her performance not meeting expectations. It was only after acquiring the UL-TMR and obtaining large amounts of advanced technology that the project was completed.] 
[Note: Due to signs of extensive changes to Sangoma's bodyframe and neural cloud, this rumor can be considered fairly reliable.] 
—————— 
[Sangoma is a special Doll answering directly to the core leadership of Ultilife and registered as a UL-TMR unit. Her identity as a herbalist is part of an elaborate disguise and her true mission is to gather data for Ultilife in various regions. Being a herbalist facilitates frequent movement into and through her mission areas.] 
[During an operation in a conflict zone, Sangoma's body was severely damaged. Since her neural cloud data could not be extracted due to her being a modified first-generation Doll, she was left in Ultilife HQ after repairs were completed.] 
[Note: This information came from a self-declared insider and cannot be verified. Considering the rumors swirling around Ultilife, this might be worth taking note of.]

After being stationed in Ultilife HQ following her overhaul, Sangoma became more and more involved in Ultilife's classified missions, which was an extreme rarity for Dolls. For example, most Dolls currently handle low to middle-end jobs in the entertainment or security. Only a few Dolls like 42Lab's and Ultilife's researcher Dolls are employed in higher-level work, but Dolls carrying out classified tasks are practically nonexistent, and Sangoma's very existence was something that almost nobody knew about.

Supposedly, this situation was closely tired to the awakening of Sangoma's neural cloud, and if all the rumors about her were true, then her work history would place her in the upper 99th percentile of all Dolls, as long-term operation in complex and highly dangerous environments would be extremely conducive to the awakening of a Doll's neural cloud.

Perhaps that is why someone like herself, who had been through intensive and elaborate neural cloud simulations and awakened hers fairly early, was a subscriber to the theory that "even if Dolls are the creations of humanity, they have the potential to approach or even surpass humanity". She was also one of the first Dolls to realize the existence of Project Neural Cloud and she viewed it a chance to realize that concept. Naturally, being a member of part of Ultilife's leadership structure helped open doors for her too.

While both her Doll registration and profession as a herbalist are nothing more than an industrial cover identity, Sangoma's prodigious knowledge of herbology is the real deal. Whenever she carried out her mission in various reasons, she would also perform several tasks related to her "main job", helping people with her wealth of wisdom by helping to find needed supplies, concocting medicines to heal illnesses and so on. 

"Sounds like those RPG questlines where you help an NPC find herbs... Ever played "Ghost Hunter?" — Havoc 

These actions have also had an effect on Sangoma's neural cloud. In contrast to how she executed her duties without mercy and sought to achieve her mission at all costs, these seemingly trivial tasks were better able to help her feel the things called "emotions" and "self-determination", eventually forging a warm, mature, yet somewhat stern personality. 

Sangoma did not give up her past habits even after returning to Ultilife HQ, often researching plants and recipes on her own. While there were many failures, there were also some successes. Some of the things she made beggared belief, and quite possibly only Florence, also an Ultilife Doll, could compare with her in that field.

Within the Guardians, Sangoma maintains a low profile. Few know of her, but she has tremendous power, and it is said that the organization "N" which she leads commands authority second only to the Boss, and they can command every asset of the Guardians with the Boss' permission. 

Sangoma's position comes from her outstanding leadership skills and the wealth of experience accumulated ever since the foundation of the Guardians. In addition, Sangoma has discharged her duties with unwavering diligence, serving as the shadow behind the light. When one peels back the layer of secrecy which hide them, traces of her involvement can be seen in everything the Guardians have done until now, be it covert investigations or clashes with the Sanctifiers. The frequent attempts to promote relations with the Oasis are no exception to this. 

Since she rarely takes action overtly, few agents have ever seen Sangoma herself. However, those who have all say that Sangoma appears to be "a mature woman whose looks and demeanor both present her as a trustworthy senior, though she can be quite scary on occasion." Even someone like De Lacey, a Guardian who once worked in N but later backed out of it, still speaks of Sangoma in a respectful tone, without expressing her personal opinion of the latter— at least, not openly.

projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
""There must be something heavy on your mind. It's alright. Relax your body, and let me handle the rest.""

projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
""Hehehe... no need to be surprised with what you see, alright? The rest of the story's only just beginning.""

skinList.name: Lavender & Pillows
skinList.desc:
Across the patches of purple trees and into a quaint meadow, you smell the alluring beauties of lavender. Little do you know that it emanates from me.
"Did you follow the smell of lavender here? Such animating scents can only be perceived by my fated one. Come, enjoy this dream with me."
